CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.website_font_admin_catalog()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',f.family->'id','family_name',f.family->'family_name',
    'enabled',f.family->'enabled','created_at',f.family->'created_at',
    'updated_at',f.family->'updated_at','in_use',f.family->'in_use',
    'faces',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'asset_id',x.face->'asset_id','weight',x.face->'weight','style',x.face->'style'
    ) order by x.ordinal) from jsonb_array_elements(f.family->'faces')
      with ordinality x(face,ordinal)), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) order by f.ordinal),'[]'::jsonb)
  from jsonb_array_elements(private.website_font_server_catalog())
    with ordinality f(family,ordinal);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_website_font_delivery_asset(p_asset_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'asset_id',x.asset_id,
    'storage_path',x.storage_path,
    'mime_type',x.mime_type,
    'byte_size',x.byte_size,
    'sha256',x.sha256
  )
  from public.website_font_faces x
  join public.website_font_families f on f.id=x.family_id
  where x.asset_id=p_asset_id and f.enabled
    and private.website_font_in_use(f.id)
    and private.website_font_reference_valid('custom:'||f.id::text);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.website_font_server_catalog()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',f.id,'family_name',f.family_name,'enabled',f.enabled,
    'created_at',f.created_at,'updated_at',f.updated_at,
    'in_use',private.website_font_in_use(f.id),
    'faces',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'asset_id',x.asset_id,'weight',x.weight,'style',x.style,'storage_path',x.storage_path,
      'mime_type',x.mime_type,'byte_size',x.byte_size,'sha256',x.sha256
    ) order by x.weight,x.style) from public.website_font_faces x where x.family_id=f.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) order by f.normalized_name), '[]'::jsonb)
  from public.website_font_families f;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_website_font_management_catalog()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select private.website_font_server_catalog();
$function$
